confidence_notes: Beer, coffee and inexpensive-meal anchors rest on aggregated cost-of-living figures (Numbeo, Expatistan, MyLifeElsewhere) and are reasonably supported. Cocktail anchors use Expatistan's crowdsourced average and happy-hour listings as a cross-check. The mid-range meal, wine glass and all four accommodation anchors are model estimates, not searched figures; accommodation was not searched, per instructions, and no live listings were inspected. Wine uses the local beer relationship because no reliable Honolulu wine-by-the-glass average was found. FX caveat: the only RBA observation I could identify is 0.7088 USD per AUD dated 2026-03-20, taken from a search-result snippet of the RBA exchange-rates page. I did not open that page, and this is not the latest observation available on 2026-10-16. I could not retrieve a later RBA figure within the search limit, so the FX value should be refreshed from rba.gov.au before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was needed. Honolulu is a US city, so the North America basis applies, anchored to Honolulu-specific aggregated price data where available. Wine is estimated from the beer anchor, and the mid-range meal and accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for a July 2026 tourist-season window.
